title: 第一卷 第3章 背后有帝族何必靠自己第一卷 第4章 清月烈阳血脉升华
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
lines: 【叮咚，恭喜宿主与道侣林清雅（评分95）完成圆房，奖励结算中……】
【获得奖励：大品仙王诀（仙阶功法）、乾坤熔炉（极道帝兵）、天圣丹（造化仙丹，体质升华）*2、修为灌顶（天武巅峰）】
奖励到账，姜无痕顿时面露狂喜之色。
仙阶功法！
而且还是完整的！
即便是帝族姜家，也只有一部仙阶功法的残篇，族中历代先祖东拼西凑，将自己对道法的感悟加了进去，勉强能修炼。
但比起帝阶功法，实则强不了多少。
有了这部完整的《大品仙王诀》，自己的大帝老爹绝对可以在有生之年，突破到更高的境界！
相比之下，极道帝兵的价值就低了许多。
毕竟，姜家是有大帝坐镇的，也曾诞生过不止一尊大帝，族中不缺极道帝兵。
但，谁又会嫌自家极道帝兵多呢？
而天圣丹，作为超越帝阶宝丹的造化仙丹，居然能令体质升华！
修仙界特殊体质虽种类繁多，品阶划分却并不复杂，由低到高分别为：凡体、灵体、王体、神体、圣体、道体！
圣体大成，可叫板大帝！
至于道体，传说与天地大道亲和，只要不陨落，必定能证道成帝！
一枚天圣丹，足以让特殊体质提升一阶！
而修为灌顶……
阎浮大世界修炼境界，由低到高可划分为：淬体境、炼气境、命宫境、天武境、洞天境、化龙境、阴阳境、神武境、轮回劫境、涅槃圣境、准帝境、帝境！
从淬体境到天武境，称作武者四境，乃是修炼的基础。
洞天境到神武境，称作生死四境，是修炼者超脱生死，命格升华的过程。
从轮回劫境开始，便要与天争寿，每次突破都要渡劫。
这也是强者的开端，劫境强者被成为尊者！
涅槃圣境，看似是一个境界，其实是三个境界的统称，分别是——圣人，圣人王，大圣！
而准帝与帝境，则是当世巅峰！
【是否接受修为灌顶？】
系统提示，随之而来。
“接受！”
音落的刹那，一股暖流自姜无痕体内催生，多年无法破开的桎梏，在此刻顿开。
伴随着阵阵舒爽，姜无痕忍不住发出低吟，气息以肉眼可见的速度攀升着！
淬体境第一重！
淬体境第二重！
淬体境第九重！
突破！
炼气境第一重！
命宫境第九重！
只在短短数息之间，天武境九重巅峰，水到渠成！
这样的境界，放眼帝族姜家，或许连一些刚出生的孩子都不如。
一些准帝或大圣的子嗣，天生命格强悍，出生就有洞天境，甚至化龙境的修为，这并不奇怪。
content_en:
[Ding dong, congratulations to the host and Taoist companion Lin Qingya (score 95) for consummating their marriage, the rewards are being settled...]
[Rewards obtained: Great Immortal King Technique (immortal-level skills), Qiankun Furnace (Jidao Emperor Weapon), Tiansheng Dan (creation elixir, physical sublimation)*2, cultivation initiation (Tianwu Peak)]
When the reward arrived, Jiang Wuhen suddenly looked ecstatic.
Immortal level skills!
And it’s still complete!
Even the Jiang family of the Imperial Clan only has a fragment of the Immortal Level Cultivation Technique. The ancestors of the clan pieced it together here and there, adding their own understanding of Taoism to it, and could barely practice it.
But compared to the Emperor level skills, they are not much better.
With this complete "The Art of the Great Immortal King", my father, the great emperor, will definitely be able to break through to a higher realm in his lifetime!
In comparison, the value of the Jidao Emperor's weapons is much lower.
After all, the Jiang family has a great emperor in charge, and has given birth to more than one great emperor. There is no shortage of Ji Dao emperor soldiers in the family.
However, who would think that his own Ji Dao Emperor has too many soldiers?
And the Heavenly Saint Pill, as a creation elixir that surpasses the emperor-level treasure pill, can actually sublimate the physique!
Although there are many types of special physiques in the world of immortality, the classification of grades is not complicated. From low to high, they are: mortal body, spiritual body, royal body, divine body, holy body, and Tao body!
The completion of the Holy Body can be called the Great Emperor!
As for the Tao body, it is said that it is in harmony with the great road of heaven and earth. As long as he does not perish, he will surely become an emperor!
A Heavenly Saint Pill is enough to improve a special physique by one level!
And the cultivation initiation...
The realm of cultivation in the great world of Jamfu can be divided from low to high: body tempering realm, qi refining realm, life palace realm, heavenly martial realm, cave heaven realm, dragon transformation realm, yin and yang realm, divine martial realm, reincarnation calamity realm, nirvana holy realm, quasi-emperor realm, and emperor realm!
From the Body Tempering Realm to the Heavenly Martial Realm, they are called the Four Realms of the Warrior, which are the foundation of cultivation.
The cave heaven realm to the divine martial realm are called the four realms of life and death. They are the process by which cultivators transcend life and death and sublimate their destiny.
From the beginning of the realm of reincarnation and calamity, one has to compete with the sky for longevity, and every time one breaks through, one has to overcome the calamity.
This is also the beginning of the strong. The strong in the Tribulation Realm are called venerable!
The Holy Realm of Nirvana seems to be one realm, but in fact it is the collective name of three realms, namely - Saint, Saint King, and Great Sage!
The quasi-emperors and emperor realms are at the pinnacle of the world!
[Do you accept the cultivation initiation? 】
System prompts follow.
"Accept!"
The moment the sound fell, a warm current emerged from Jiang Wuhen's body, and the shackles that had been unable to be broken for many years were suddenly lifted at this moment.
Along with the bursts of relief, Jiang Wuhen couldn't help but moan, his breath rising at a speed visible to the naked eye!
The first level of the body tempering realm!
The second level of the body tempering realm!
…
The ninth level of the body tempering realm!
breakthrough!
The first level of Qi Refining Realm!
…
The ninth level of Life Palace Realm!
…
In just a few breaths, reaching the peak of the ninth level of the Tianwu realm was a matter of course!
In such a state, if you look at the Jiang family of the imperial clan, they may not even be as good as some newborn children.
It is not surprising that some descendants of quasi-emperors or great saints are born with strong personalities and have the cultivation of the cave heaven realm or even the dragon realm.
